title: 明早不必慌张
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表右：原深蓝星星睡帽和黄色帽球，保留原兔体型；玩偶和毛毯是另行配置的场景道具。
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the RIGHT bedtime star cap, navy with pale yellow stars and yellow pompom. No overalls, raincoat, backpack or shoes in bed. Yellow blanket and orange carrot toy with dark green leaves are scene props, not identity changes. Scene continuity: 玄关木架前
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 夜晚的皮皮看着已放稳的藤篮，想象明早只需顺手取出手套；画面仍保持夜景，不切换成真实次日。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 松一口气，神情轻松。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 保持同一对红白条纹手套、藤篮和玄关布局；只画本镜描述的动作，不加旁白文字。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. 
Input 3: locked shared prop reference board. Reproduce the exact red-and-ivory striped knitted mitten pair, honey-brown oval wicker basket, and simple low wooden stool. Draw only the props required by this shot; never add all board items automatically.
